names.house_1736_prairie: 1736 Prairie Avenue — the Ingraham/McBirney house, its veranda front from the c. 1890 photograph

source.citation: Glessner House Museum, 'The Early History of Prairie Avenue - Part IV', The Story of a House (blog), 7 July 2020.
what_it_does_not_supply: anything of the flank, the rear or the alley building
what_it_supplies: that 1736 was a large brick house completed in 1864 for Granville S. Ingraham
the author's judgement that its mansard may well have been a later addition to an Italianate house
that Hugh McBirney lived in it for many years
